name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 19 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 20 hours starting 2025-07-19, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 2.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
